latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Text to Video — Convert Text into Shareable Videos

- Instantly convert text (TXT, DOCX, PDF, copy-paste) into videos with AI visuals and voiceover.
- Cloud-based workflow with automatic token/session setup; no local install required.
- Integrated upload, video generation, export, credits check, and live session tracking.
- Supports MP4 and other common formats; up to 1080p export included.
- User-friendly prompts and streamlined error handling—ideal for marketers and content creators.
- Batch and iterative workflows supported for efficient content repurposing.
